item.title: Trump's Lebanon ceasefire takes Israel by surprise
item.summary: Few Israelis see this truce as a way out of the conflict with Hezbollah, the BBC's Lucy Williamson writes.

item.title: Russia launches deadliest aerial attack in months, killing 18 in Ukraine
item.summary: A Ukrainian drone attack killed two people in Russia, Moscow says, after an Orthodox Easter truce.

item.title: Lyse Doucet: Under fragile ceasefire, Iranians wonder if US deal can be done
item.summary: The BBC's chief international correspondent reports from Iran as diplomatic efforts to avoid a return to war intensify.

item.title: What we know about the ceasefire between Lebanon and Israel
item.summary: A 10-day truce between the two countries is now in effect, with Iran-backed Hezbollah voicing support, as negotiations continue between the US and Iran.

item.title: Pope criticises 'tyrants' who spend billions on wars after Trump spat
item.summary: The comments follow a high-profile spat with US President Donald Trump, who called the Pope weak on crime.

item.title: Pope lashes out at foreigners who exploit Africa
item.summary: The pontiff has been unusually forthright during his visit to conflict-hit Cameroon.

item.title: Satellite images reveal scale of Israeli demolitions as Lebanese villages destroyed
item.summary: BBC Verify analysis found more than 1,400 buildings had been destroyed since 2 March.

item.title: Wanted activist arrested in South Africa over support for Benin coup plot
item.summary: Keba Seba is known for opposing French influence in Africa and backing West Africa's military leaders.

item.title: Singer D4vd arrested on suspicion of murdering teenage girl
item.summary: The remains of 14-year-old Celeste Rivas Hernandez were found in the singer's car last year.

item.title: Turkish police detain 162 people over online posts about school shootings
item.summary: At least 16 people were injured in a shooting at a high school on Tuesday, before another nine were killed in a separate school shooting on Wednesday.
